Lina S: heads-up: restore-service shows AccessDenied when decrypting a handful of object-store snapshots from 2023-12. Not total outage but 3/60 jobs failed.
Rob C: saw the same. Error: "NotAuthorizedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777:key/old-key-42" on job restore-421.
Maya: did we recently rotate or rename any service roles?
Lina S: yes we renamed role snapshot-uploader -> snapshot-uploader-main yesterday during the infra cleanup. I updated IAM policies but didnt touch KMS grants.
encops-bot: Alert: 3 decrypt failures for key old-key-42 between 2025-11-15T09:12:01Z and 2025-11-15T09:14:45Z. Sample log: 
```
2025-11-15T09:13:12Z restore-service ERROR job=restore-421 cause=AccessDenied kmsKey=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777:key/old-key-42
CausedBy: NotAuthorizedException: User arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/snapshot-uploader-main is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```
Rob C: quick inventory shows grants for key old-key-42 pointing to arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/snapshot-uploader (old). Grants are immutable so they no longer match the new role ARN.
Maya: mitigation options: 1) Create per-snapshot CreateGrant with EncryptionContextSubset, 2) temporarily update key policy to include new role, 3) use an instance assuming the legacy principal (not ideal).
Lina S: prefer targeted grants with tight encryption context. Create temporary grants and set retire-on timestamp. Also add incident ticket.
Rob C: running create-grant for snapshot ids snap-202312-10 and snap-202312-18 with constraints now. Command: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id old-key-42 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/snapshot-uploader-main --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"snapshot_id":"snap-202312-10"} --name temp-restore-202312-10
```
Response: GrantId g-temp-334.
Maya: replays succeeded for the two with temp grants.
sec-oncall: compliance ok if we: limit scope, set explicit retirement, and log operator + justification in ticket.
Lina S: action items: add KMS-grant sweep to the RBAC-rename checklist, implement an automated detector for grants pointing at nonexistent principals, and prefer key-policy statements where feasible. Opening INC-2025-882 and attaching GrantId g-temp-334.
encops-bot: Suggested audit query: SELECT GrantId, GranteePrincipal FROM kms_grants WHERE GranteePrincipal NOT IN (select arn from iam_entities)
Maya: will follow up with a scan across all CMKs for orphaned grants and propose a runbook entry. Current status: 3 failures -> 0 after temp grants and replays. Monitoring 24h. :white_check_mark:
